# CircularTech Advisory

> CircularTech Advisory is the Digital Product Passport (DPP) consulting practice of CircularTech Forum GmbH, the organiser of the CircularTech Forum. It helps manufacturers, institutions and passport service providers in the EU move from passport rules to a working passport: readiness assessments, compliance roadmaps, passport design and implementation, and circular business value.

Contact: consulting@circulartechforum.de. Language: English. Full text of this site for language models: https://www.circulartechadvisory.com/llms-full.txt

## Pages
- [Home](https://www.circulartechadvisory.com/): services, short answers on what a DPP is and which products need one, and how to get in touch
- [Services](https://www.circulartechadvisory.com/services.html): the five services in detail, what each delivers and when it fits
- [Insights](https://www.circulartechadvisory.com/insights/): analysis of EU DPP rules and what to build when

## Insights
- [The EU DPP Registry's API and battery data model are out: what to build before February 2027](https://www.circulartechadvisory.com/insights/dpp-registry-technical-package/) (2026-11-05): Battery passports must be registered from 18 February 2027. The Commission's 30 October 2026 technical package for the EU DPP Registry adds a registration API, two authentication profiles and a semantic model for batteries. What to build now.
